notes: Reference date 2018-03-12. The governing documents for MU tenure-stream faculty leave are the UM System Collected Rules (CRR 340.070 Faculty Leave, amended 2-9-17; CRR 340.010 Family and Medical Leave, 2-9-17; CRR 310.025, amended 2-9-17), which apply to all campuses including Columbia, and the MU Provost's tenure-extension guidelines (campus). So missing = false; the rule for records with no governing document (reader instructions §3) does not apply.
2018_08_mu_faculty_handbook_index is a navigation index (holds no policy text; 'Leave of Absence (CR)' points to the Collected Rules).

2018_04 CRR 340.020 Leave of Absence (1983) describes leaves 'for institutional purposes' (reflection, research, professional development) with reinstatement rights; not usable for a birth, so not a component. CRR 340.070's Research, Development and Sabbatical leaves are professional leaves, not components. Military leave not a component.
Paid FML pay level: CRR 340.070 says only 'will be paid'; no fraction stated, so pay_fraction is left empty (the derivation counts it at 100 with a note).

CRR 340.010 requires employees to use all paid time during FMLA leave but defers to CRR 340.070.B.2 for faculty ('shall control in the event of any inconsistency'), so no must_exhaust_first is coded on the faculty paid leave. HR-407 (last updated 2009) also requires accrued vacation and other paid leave to be used; it is older than and subordinate to CRR 340.010/340.070.

Conflict noted: HR-407 (2009) says intermittent or reduced-schedule leave 'is not available for birth, adoption or foster care'; CRR 340.010 (2017) allows it with supervisor approval within 12 months. The 2017 Collected Rule governs; recorded in c2 duration_note.

HR-404 Sick Leave covers administrative, service and support staff only; no faculty sick-leave policy is saved. CRR 340.070 says a faculty member covered by 'another approved University vacation/sick leave policy' is paid under it; that policy is not saved (flag on c1). CRR 340.030 Sick Leave is named only as the 'Next Rule' link on 340.020 and is not saved.

Tenure clock: CRR 340.070 D (automatic one-year extension for FML over six weeks, may decline) is c4; the Provost's guideline C ('approved upon request' for a qualifying FMLA leave) is treated as its campus procedure, not a separate component. Guideline B (birth/adoption/custody, approved upon request) is c5, linked concurrent_with c4 (V3c). CRR 310.025's chancellor-discretion extension (open list of reasons) is c6, general_purpose (U1).
Calendar: CRR 340.070 states 'the traditional semester is 16-weeks in duration' -> term_weeks 16.

Birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c2) with the Paid Family and Medical Leave, up to 12 weeks, within it (c1) -> [discretionary/negotiated only] paid differentiated workload, classroom release for the balance of the semester, containing the leave (c3; c1 within c3). Tenure clock +1 year (c4, with c5 concurrent). General leave without pay up to 1 year after FMLA (c7, general_purpose, uncounted).

Non-birth parent chain: identical to the birth parent's: FMLA 12 (c2) with paid FML 12 within it (c1) -> [negotiated] relief for the balance of the semester containing the leave (c3). No role-specific provision in any source.

Documents cited but not saved: CRR 340.070 campus application/review processes for personal leave; 'another approved University vacation/sick leave policy' (faculty); HR 402 Vacation, HR 403 Personal Days, HR 408 Leaves of Absence, HR 409 Work-Incurred Injury or Illness (HR-407 See Also); HR 404 Questions and Answers; HR 203, HR 307, Human Resources Benefits Handbooks-Retirement, Disability and Death (HR-404 See Also); University benefit programs--optional long-term disability income protection (CRR 310.020); CRR 340.030 Sick Leave; CRR 320.025 (Provost guideline on early tenure consideration); CRR 310.060, 310.070, 370.010, 600.040 (tenure procedures, not leave).

Statutory baseline (US): FMLA row coded as c2 (verified against statute text 2026_00_us_fmla_29usc2612); no Missouri rows exist in statutory_baseline.csv, and no saved document names a Missouri leave statute.
